_README: The standing prior-art recall benchmark. Six subjects, on purpose.
WHY MORE THAN ONE. Run-to-run variance is +/-2 families, so a '+1' on a single subject is
noise, and changes have been adopted and rejected on differences that size. Subjects also fail
for OPPOSITE reasons, and a change that trades one for another looks neutral on either alone:
ep3707092   22 cited families, most of them IN this corpus. Tests RANKING.
schmalz     10 cited documents, four classified in acoustics, exhaust silencers, vacuum
cleaners and power tools, outside the eight CPC branches indexed here. Tests
REACH: no ranking change can produce a document never retrieved from anywhere.
the other four   X/Y-coded search-report citations, all in corpus. Pure RANKING tests, and
they carry the spread of sub-topic and decade the first two lack.
WHAT COUNTS AS GOLD. citations.origin carries the search-report relevance code: X is
particularly relevant on its own, Y is relevant in combination, A is background. X and Y are
what threatens novelty and inventive step. The applicant's IDS (category APP) is NOT gold: one
US patent here carries 5,771 of those against 11 from the search report, and an IDS is a dump
of everything the applicant knew, not the result of a search. See eval/collect_subject.py.
Add subjects with collect_subject.py; nothing in the harness is specific to any of them.
